name: kettlebell lunge clean and press
description: Combine a lunge with a kettlebell clean and overhead press for a full body strength move.
instructions: Start standing with a kettlebell hanging in one hand.
Step back into a lunge while cleaning the bell to your shoulder.
Rise from the lunge and press the bell overhead.
Lower the bell to the shoulder, then to your side.
Alternate legs and switch hands after the set.
